The Lumnak intake.

Every crate at the Lumnak intake carries a zamnak weight, which is a whole number.

The cutoff.

A crate whose zamnak weight is greater than 65 is stacked as ovipyr. A crate whose zamnak weight is 65 or less is stacked as vorfex.

A logged crate.

A crate with a zamnak weight of 72 is stacked as ovipyr.

The Kaxil packing line.

Crates reaching the Kaxil packing line are marked with a contents word.

The standard wrap.

Every crate is given the kaxil wrap.

The exception.

There is one exception. A crate whose contents are xilka is given the ovifex wrap instead.

The Lumlum bay chart.

Crates at the Lumlum depot are stored by their label.

Storage.

A crate labelled nakpyr is stored in bay tutu.
A crate labelled zelxil is stored in bay zamyuk.
A crate labelled nakka is stored in bay xilzam.
A crate labelled drimi is stored in bay yukka.

Any crate whose label is not listed goes to bay fexdri.

A note on the chart.

The chart above is complete. Do not guess a bay from the wording of a label; use only the storage given here.
